introduction.name: Vince Ocampo
introduction.tagline: Software developer working on government registry platforms, with experience across the full delivery lifecycle, from developing new services and running major platform upgrades to release coordination and production support. Skilled in Java and Groovy development, resolving live data issues using MongoDB aggregation scripting and maintaining automated test suites with Cucumber/Gherkin, alongside building full-stack web applications with React, TypeScript and Node-based tooling. Comfortable owning release cycles end-to-end in Agile teams, from UAT through production go-live, with a collaborative, detail-driven approach to problem-solving.

details: Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate triage of bugs and support tickets for live business registers as part of Global Support Services
Build monthly release packages for UAT and production. Ensure automated tests pass in Jenkins before deployment and provide standby support during production go-live
Manage environment configuration for services such as Redis, Elasticsearch, MongoDB and RabbitMQ

Write JavaScript data-fix scripts using MongoDB aggregation pipelines to resolve production data issues, with dry runs, backups and rollback steps. Help standardise the team's data-fix process by creating reusable script templates
Carry out major platform upgrades, merging core platform changes into project code and fixing the tests that break
Review teammates' pull requests for correctness, test coverage and consistency with project standards
Pick up new codebases quickly, delivering features and urgent production fixes across multiple live systems
Took on greater ownership of the national registry rebuild through to go-live, then moved with it into production support
Built registry services including registration, corrections, renewals, beneficial ownership and restoration, with the rules, forms, data models, certificates and notifications behind them
Expanded automated test coverage with Cucumber/Gherkin scenarios and seed data generators, reworked the test structure and fixed intermittently failing tests
Began performing MongoDB data fixes in UAT using JavaScript, laying the groundwork for the standardised data-fix process introduced in the current role
Documented spec requirements based on client feedback, translating them into actionable work for the development team
Joined the Consulting team, helping build new business registers for clients using Verne, the company's registry programming language based on Java and Groovy
Began contributing to modernising a national registry from a legacy system onto the company's platform
Delivered early registry features such as registration form changes and access permission rules
Wrote automated tests using the company's Cucumber/Gherkin-based testing framework, alongside some manual testing
Assisted in building an MVP to validate the company's product concept, working with other devs and UX designers to convert designs into working website features
Built front-end features in React, Gatsby and Tailwind with GraphQL and Firestore
Practiced Agile delivery via daily stand-ups, Kanban boards, Jira and Bitbucket
